title: dmart_operational_positioning_strategy
claim: Low-price positioning is funded by operational supply chain leverage rather than marketing budgets.
hook: Most retail analysis focuses on ad campaigns. This brand case study India shows why payment terms beat advertising.

reel_script.onscreen: The cheapest retail brand does not cut ads.
reel_script.voiceover: The cheapest retailer in India does not win by cutting ad budgets.
DMart stays cheaper than modern retail by fixing one contract term: vendor payment velocity.
reel_script.direction: Text graphic overlay over DMart store footage.

reel_script.voiceover: The industry standard for retail credit is 45 days. DMart settles supplier invoices in 8.
reel_script.direction: Rachit back on camera contrasting the numbers.

reel_script.voiceover: In exchange, suppliers give them a 2% cash discount. DMart passes that 2% directly to consumer prices.
reel_script.direction: Diagram showing cash flow to consumer price reduction.

reel_script.voiceover: They also buy store land instead of leasing, cutting another 7% out of operational costs.
Here is the 3-part test for low-cost trade leverage:

reel_script.onscreen: 1. DPO under 10d  2. Owned land  3. SKU cap
reel_script.voiceover: One: Days payable under 10. Two: Real estate ownership over leasing. Three: SKU cap under 4,000.
Positioning is not what you tell customers. It is how your operating model funds your price.
reel_script.direction: Rachit on camera delivering the closing principle.

caption:
Most retail analysis focuses on ad campaigns. This brand case study India shows why payment terms beat advertising.

FMCG brands usually offer higher retail margins to get shelf space. DMart flipped that leverage entirely.

By reducing payment terms from 45 days to 8, suppliers willingly traded a 2% cash discount for guaranteed working capital.

DMart does not sell shelf space; it sells inventory velocity. If an SKU does not turn over in 14 days, it is delisted.

Low price is not a messaging strategy. It is an operational balance sheet.

Send this to whoever is defending your retail trade margins this quarter.
